purpose: Derive deterministic non-normative grammar records and evidence-aware knowledge-root projections from typed contracts without embedding Quranic verse text.
invariants: Every record binds the contract-set root and rule IDs.
Every current record uses split=research and normative=false.
No raw QAC row or Quranic verse text is emitted.
Observed lexical associations are Positive only when their source edge passes its contract.
Controlled invalid mutations are Negative; contradictory source evidence remains Unverified.
Every positive state and its mutations share one deterministic leakage group.
Reserved normative buckets never change the current research split.
Projection text, SHA-256 index keys, and shards are Data, not neural embeddings.
verification: 184 corpus records: 51 Positive and 133 controlled Negative
51 leakage groups covering 184 records with zero cross-split leakage
Split manifest root c39aeda6...f14e with byte-identical replay
claimBoundary: Derived Data artifact; not an authorized CNS training split.
